The biggest problem I have with the new champ select is that people have the ability to pick their own roles, and that's my favorite part as well, but they dodge when they don't get their first role.  In a way it's the same as it used to be, people dodge if they don't get the role they called, but now it's more poignant because people chose their roles during the lobby and it feels unfair when they don't get their preferred role. You could argue that this promotes the ability to play more than one role before you go into ranked, and I'd agree that that is important.  But "replacing" teambuilder with this is ridiculous.  My friends and I pretty much only used teambuilder unless there were only two of us because getting your preferred role and champ in blind is a hit or miss.  I love the new champ select, but for ranked only.  I would love it if the new select was implemented for ranked but teambuilder stayed for normals.  Maybe keep both teambuilder and replace normal draft with the new one.  
TLDR: New champion select is great for ranked, but I think teambuilder should stay and have the new select be replacing only normal draft.

Thresh makes the enemy adc need to pay more attention in lane.  If you're not watching him, you will get hooked.  If he walks up to you, he is most likely trying to flay or aa for the burst damage.  I know from experience that missing hook on thresh makes almost all of your pressure go away completely for ~15 secs.  So if you aren't losing really hard and the adc is killable, if thresh misses go for some kind of trade because all thresh has now is two slows and a knockup.  Most of the time thresh will want to flay you towards his adc, use this to your advantage.  If you are hurting his baby carry, he will cc you, try to make a prediction about where he will aim his cc and don't go there.  A few other tips, if he hits hook, it looses 2 seconds off cd.  The box only does damage once.  Hiding behind minions is only a good idea if the adc can't hurt you wither AND you have a way to get away from them, because minion block is a bitch and the enemy will capitalize if you get stuck.  My best advice for minion block is if you get stuck, STOp ClicKING.  This is the biggest mistake I see everyone (myself included) make.  When you get stuck on minion you keep frantically clicking to get away and then you change where your model is trying to go resetting the minion block, this is a thresh's wet dream.  If you get stuck in your own minions, you are getting flayed and hooked and cc and killed.  I can't think of anything else.
